ADC_EVENT_TYPES

Table to store page item events supported by ADC.

Columns
cet_id

PK, alphanumerical key

cet_pti_id

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, translatable NAME

cet_pmg_name

Reference to PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM, fixed to ADC

cet_cpitg_id

Reference to ADC_PAGE_ITEM_TYPE_GROUPS, fixed to EVENT

cet_column_name

Name of the event column in the decision table

cet_is_custom_event

Flag to indicate whether this event has to be observed explicitly by a rule action

References

cet_pti_id, cet_pmg_name -> PIT_TRANSLATABLE_ITEM (pti_uid, pti_upmg) cet_cpitg_id - references ADC_PAGE_ITEM_TYPE_GROUPS (cpitg_id)
